def rotate_180(grid):
    return [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]

def row_sums(grid):
    return [sum(row) for row in grid]

def count_value_occurrences(grid, value):
    return sum(row.count(value) for row in grid)

def grid_sum(grid):
    return sum(sum(row) for row in grid)

def reverse_rows_elements(grid):
    return [row[::-1] for row in grid]

def flip_vertical(grid):
    return grid[::-1]

def count_greater_than(grid, threshold):
    return sum(1 for row in grid for val in row if val > threshold)
